instruction_trace_scope: Wrapper functions only; original inflater executes without per-instruction Python callbacks.
adapters: Original stored/DEFLATE payload reader, local-header offsets, inflate initialization, raw inflater and teardown execute original instructions. CRT seek/read and memory allocation/free/cookie adapted.

Original archive bytes and central metadata supplied; entry vector/output capacity preallocated, process allocator initialized. Native output compared byte-for-byte with independently decoded zipfile output.
limits: Successful complete streams and allocations; vector growth, malformed DEFLATE, short reads, allocation errors and archive mounting still open.
